entities.name: Stahaan
entities.description: An island in the extreme north of the Domains on Dominaria, and the name of the dominant minotaur tribe there.

entities.name: Stahaan minotaurs
entities.description: A xenophobic, orthodox minotaur nation led by the Speaker of Stone.

entities.name: Mirtiin
entities.description: Sister nation of minotaurs living in the Mirtiin Mountains.

entities.name: Hurloon minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs exiled from Stahaan as heretics.

entities.name: Speaker of Stone
entities.description: A matriarch-priestess who is the nation's spiritual and political leader.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane on which Stahaan lies.

entities.name: Boiling Lake
entities.description: A hot spring lake on Stahaan.

entities.name: Null Divva
entities.description: A remote human settlement known for glass production.

entities.name: Lemeya
entities.description: Whose sacred texts are preserved in the Holy Library.

events.summary: The Hurloon minotaurs are exiled from Stahaan as heretics for believing humans and minotaurs share a common ancestor.
events.quote: The Hurloon minotaurs were exiled from Stahaan as heretics

relations.note: Sister nation on the same island.
relations.quote: serving as a sister nation to the Mirtiin
